subject: Tenant zones and keystore residency — quick clarification & next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@novamed.com>, Michael Liu <michael.liu@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant zones and keystore residency — quick clarification & next steps

Hi Sara / Michael — thanks again for taking time today. Short recap and 2 asks so we can land an accurate recommendation for deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC):

Recap (from our call)
- NovaMed’s primary requirement: cryptographic separation of PHI model inputs and derived artifacts for regulated workflows.
- You prefer us to avoid Redwood-managed key material in the production path unless explicitly authorized.
- Throughput target: ~4500 reqs/min peak (text classification + embeddings) with avg seq length ~512 tokens.

Open questions / asks
1) Keystore residency: is NovaMed open to a Dedicated deployment where Redwood hosts the inference runtime but NovaMed supplies a customer-managed key via our KMS integration (Redwood holds only wrapped keys), or do you require full VPC Private deployment with an on-prem HSM (no key material leaving your network)? Please reply with preferred option (Dedicated with CMK OR Private VPC + on‑prem HSM).
2) Audit evidence: we discussed providing a sample encryption flow diagram and an operations checklist. Which set of artifacts would you like first — SOC2 control mappings + keyflow diagram, or a POC runbook with network ACLs and KV cache handling?

Attachments: I attached a short keystore options brief and a preliminary BOM estimate for Dedicated and Private paths.

Next steps (what I'll do)
- If you pick Dedicated+CMK: I’ll send a KMS integration spec and a proposed canary plan for a single tenant to validate key wrapping and audit trails.
- If you pick Private VPC: I’ll coordinate a VPC/peering checklist and propose on-prem HSM onboarding windows with our infra team.

Please reply with your preferred keystore residency option and which artifact set you want first. If easier, we can do a 20-min follow-up tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood_keystore_options.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
Attachment: novamed-ma-ops-bom.xlsx (estimates)
From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@novamed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Liu <michael.liu@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Tenant zones and keystore residency — quick clarification & next steps

Vivek — thanks for the recap. A couple quick clarifications from our end:

1) Keystore residency: Our compliance team strongly prefers that private key material never be escrowed by a vendor. We can support either: 
   • Dedicated + customer-managed keys where the HSM/KMS is in our cloud account and Redwood integrates via a cross-account KMS grant (preferred), OR
   • Private VPC on-prem HSM for a stricter posture (this has longer lead time).

2) Evidence: start with the SOC2 control mapping + keyflow diagram. That will let our security folks triage faster.

On the Dedicated path: can you confirm whether Redwood performs any periodic key rotation that would require access to plaintext key material? We want to ensure rotation operations are compatible with cross-account grants without key import/export to Redwood.

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful — Michael and I are around tomorrow afternoon.

—Sara
Sara Jensen
Head of Security, NovaMed Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@novamed.com>, Michael Liu <michael.liu@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant zones and keystore residency — quick clarification & next steps

Sara — great, that's helpful. Short answers and a proposed artifact delivery: 

- Key rotation: Redwood never requires plaintext key export/import. For the Dedicated + cross-account KMS flow we use key-wrapping and envelope encryption. We rotate our wrapping keys on schedule, but customer CMKs remain under your control; rotation flows are performed via cross-account grants or by you rotating the CMK per your policy. I will include a short sequence diagram showing rotation and audit events.

- Artifact delivery: I’ll send the SOC2 control map + keyflow diagram by EOD today and a Dedicated integration spec by tomorrow morning. If you confirm Dedicated+CMK is acceptable as your initial preferred path, we’ll draft a minimal canary runbook (single tenant, 2-week validation window).

Action: Sara, please confirm whether you prefer Dedicated+CMK as the initial pilot or if you want to start planning for Private VPC right away. If you choose Dedicated, we will not request access to plaintext keys and will provide audit hooks + CloudTrail examples.

Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-keystore-options (keystore brief)

Thanks — I’ll also loop in Solutions Engineering to scope throughput and PKI details once you confirm the path.

Best,
Vivek
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: NovaMed keystore preference — ops asks and next actions

Team — internal note after Sara's reply. Key points and asks for ops/SE: 

Summary: NovaMed is leaning Dedicated + cross-account CMK (preferred) but retains option to require Private VPC / on‑prem HSM later. They require: no plaintext key escrow, rotation compatibility, and SOC2 control mapping.

Immediate asks:
- Kimberly: please prepare SOC2 control mapping + keyflow diagram (I attached the redwood_keystore_options.pdf we sent). Aim for EOD today.
- Lauren / Aditya: if we proceed with Dedicated pilot, we need a canary runbook that covers:
  * cross-account KMS grant steps (docs + IAM snippets)
  * CloudTrail/audit hooks we will expose
  * network ACLs and tenant isolation notes for the single-tenant canary
  * preliminary cost/BOM: novamed-ma-ops-bom.xlsx (attached)

I'll coordinate timing with NovaMed once the artifacts are ready.

Thanks — Vivek
